title: The ML platform: clusters, GPUs and training
summary: What MLOps adds to software delivery; Kubernetes and EKS as the substrate; experiment tracking; GPUs as cluster resources; multi-node training; scheduling and tenancy of a shared cluster.
intro: This module covers the substrate of an ML platform and its training side. It starts with what MLOps adds to ordinary software delivery and the Kubernetes and AWS (EKS) foundations the rest runs on. It then covers training infrastructure: how runs are recorded with experiment tracking, how GPUs are exposed to Kubernetes, how one job spans many nodes, and how a shared cluster decides who runs when. It closes with the system design needed to share the platform safely across many tenants.
